findings.detail: Exactly 31 historical portrait records were added from the six reviewed country fragments. Each added full portrait dictionary equals its fragment; person IDs, saved names and unrelated person fields remain unchanged. Existing source URL lists changed only by the unions requested by those fragments.

All 107 previous portrait records and their order are unchanged. The 620-person registry is byte-identical to the base Git blob. All six original country render-return files remain byte-identical to their base Git blobs; their historical review states were not rewritten.

All 31 selected outputs match their retained tool-output originals byte-for-byte. The exact prompt text and SHA256, ordered actual input paths and hashes, source-reference records, derivative licences and appearance windows match the versioned generation records and source fragments. Referenced generation JSON paths resolve even when embedded in manifest prose. Open Government Licence v1.0 and the exact Creative Commons ShareAlike versions remain explicit.

Yamaguchi's 2015 portrait used the separately recorded 2048-by-1365 transport copy, not the retained 8256-by-5504 original. Both hashes, the proportional uncropped resize operation and the earlier failed original-input transport attempt remain recorded. The identity source continues to identify the retained original; the actual supplied input is not conflated with it.

The literal runtime allowlist adds exactly 38 keys: the 31 selected additions plus seven already registered France portraits. It removes no prior keys and includes all 138 historical assets. Held Doi and Gorbachev v1 outputs, the superseded Lupi 2015 v1 job, and the rejected Lupi attempt remain unavailable through this table.

The two warning entries concern byte-identical copies of a legitimate multi-person 11 November 2009 J. Batista / Câmara dos Deputados reference photograph. The Temer prompt selects the silver-haired man on the right; the Lupi prompt selects the central man holding the open green diploma folder. Their IDs, prompt files and generated output hashes are distinct. This is shared source photography, not duplicate generated character art. Warnings and originals are preserved.

Independently viewed the selected Doi v2 and its original 2005 reference during this integration review. The selected output retains a mature face and neck lines within the illustration style. Clothing and interpretation of the earlier requested window remain authored and do not create historical date or office evidence. The approved v2, not held v1, is registered.

Independently viewed the selected Gorbachev v2 after previously viewing the original reference and held v1. The corrected mark has a broader irregular lateral arc, lower lobe and flecks on anatomical right / viewer left, addressing the reduced-mark deviation. It remains a stylized likeness, not a traced facsimile. The accepted reference date remains October 1991 at month precision. The fresh v2 generation used the style anchor and original photograph in that order; it did not use v1 as an edit input.
